title: Experts disagree on hasPendingExpertConflict in src/cli/commands/spec-pipeline.ts
context:
Chief architect: These two claims fit together. The security-auditor states the rule (a legacy expert-disagreement question with no change named still holds the questions step for every change) and the qa-engineer states the test (another change's question lets this change through, this change's question still holds it). Both are true at once and the build should do both; the qa-engineer claim is picked only because it is the testable form. It matches product-owner-5 and user-flow-writer-8. Quick confirm.

Target: hasPendingExpertConflict in src/cli/commands/spec-pipeline.ts
- security-auditor: the per-change filter must treat a pending spec.expert_conflict packet with no change as belonging to every change, so legacy packets still hold record questions
- qa-engineer: Given a pending expert conflict for another change, when record questions runs for this change, then it is allowed; given one for this change, it is still refused (integration test through assertCanRunStep)
